newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tsumura seen posting 1996/97 net loss -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Tsumura seen posting 1996/97 net loss -- paper.

text.p: Chinese medicine maker Tsumura & Co is likely to post a parent net loss of about 1.5 billion yen in the fiscal year to the end of March, a Japanese business daily said on Thursday.
Tsumura"s parent current profit in 1996/97 is also expected to fall about 60 percent on a year-on-year basis, to about 3.5 billion yen, the paper said.
Tsumura, however, is expected to maintain an annual dividend of 10 yen, the paper said.
Tsumura was not immediately available for comment.
Tsumura is suffering falling sales of its main Chinese medicine product and sluggish sales of other products, the newspaper said.
Tsumura is expected to include an extraordinary loss in its 1996/97 earnings of more than six billion yen, stemming mainly from the likely liquidation of one of its subsidiaries, the newspaper said.
